name: justintube-ytdlp
description: yt-dlp container providing an Express API for Justintube URL imports
author: Justin Tavares

scripts.dev: docker build -t justintube-ytdlp . && docker run --rm --env-file=.env -p 3001:3001 -e MEDIA_STORAGE_DIRECTORY=/media -e SHARED_DATA_DIR=/data/shared -v "%cd%/media:/media" -v "%cd%/data/shared:/data/shared" --name justintube-ytdlp justintube-ytdlp
